name: keyed_map_decode_preserves_field_order
description: Keyed-map decode must reconstruct each member value object in the declared field-union order (z,a,m), not sorted. A decoder that rebuilds members into an unordered map re-encodes lexicographically (a,m,z) and fails the round-trip. Object key ordering is a preserved round-trip property (SPEC lines 52, 931).
